now.title: Luke Cage S2#13
now.text: Tilda Johnson treats Luke's concussion at her herbal shop while he hunts Bushmaster, and he pulls her and her mother Mariah Dillard out of a burning building. She later poisons Mariah and turns on Luke when Mariah leaves Harlem's Paradise to him instead of her.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Mariah's daughter, who treats Luke, then turns on him.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The man Tilda treats, then turns on when Mariah leaves him her club.

proposed.text: Tilda poisons her mother Mariah, and when Mariah's will leaves Harlem's Paradise to Luke instead of her, she turns on him.

changes.evidence: The stage text repeats events from earlier titles (treating Luke's concussion, the rescue from the burning building). In Luke Cage S2#13 Tilda gives Mariah a slow-acting poison, Mariah dies while Luke is visiting, and the changed will leaving the club to Luke angers Tilda.

owner_calls.question: Is a name in May's phone contacts enough for a connection? The two never meet or speak on screen, and the stage itself says nothing more is shown.
options: Keep the connection as an Easter egg
owner_calls.evidence: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#4 'Face My Enemy' shows Natasha Romanoff among the contacts on May's phone. That is the only on-screen link between them.
